verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email product, but nothing in the evidence shows Gmail can be deployed on user-controlled infrastructure. Offline access, IMAP/POP/SMTP access from third-party clients, and custom-domain business email are adjacent features, not self-hosting of the core product. Community mentions of self-hosted Dovecot describe users leaving Gmail, not a Gmail capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
